title: 放射性废物：从实验台到安全处置（国内版）

author_source: project/RSO Training Series/03_Dr. Bob Emery, Radiation Safety Officer, UT Health Science Center（国内版）/src.py

points.K3: 放射性物质推动医学进步
points.K5: 专人收集，送专用处理间
points.K6: 检查评估，专用容器封装

points.K8: 装满密封贴标，送去处置
points.K9: 暂时存放，安全安保第一
points.K10: 教学楼不是长期贮存库
points.K11: 这是所有医学科研机构的共同难题
points.K12: 废物多是干燥固体，层层包装
points.K13: 安保要求高，集中处置更稳妥
points.S5: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
points.S7: 处理废物的防护与监测

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排贴着电离辐射标志的废物桶前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of closed waste drums with ionizing radiation warning signs and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们聊聊放射性废物。
overlay: 放射性废物：从实验台到安全处置

shots.scene: 试管、手套、废物桶、仓库四个图标用箭头连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: Four icons linked by arrows: a test tube, a glove, a waste drum and a storage building. No people.
shots.narration: 它从哪来，又要到哪里去。

shots.scene: 阿杰做完实验，摘下手套正要扔进普通垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes an experiment, takes off his gloves and is about to toss them into an ordinary trash bin.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完同位素实验，随手要扔手套。

shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住，指向旁边贴着电离辐射标志的专用废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a dedicated waste bin with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这可是放射性废物！

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看看手套又看看两个桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at the gloves and then at the two bins.
shots.narration: 阿杰不解：一副手套，有那么讲究吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣在两个桶之间竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the two bins and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从头说起。

shots.scene: 实验台和病床两个图标，中间一条发光的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab bench and a hospital bed connected by a glowing arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 医学研究讲究从实验台走到病床边。
overlay: 从实验台到病床

shots.scene: 小研在实验台前看显微镜，旁边浮现一个灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks into a microscope at a lab bench, with a light bulb icon floating above.
shots.narration: 实验室里的发现，最终用来治病救人。

shots.section_title: 放射性示踪：在原子水平看生命
shots.scene: 一个带发光小点的分子在细胞图里移动，留下轨迹
shots.prompt_en: A molecule with a tiny glowing dot moves through a cell diagram, leaving a trail. No people.
shots.narration: 给分子挂上放射性标记，就能追踪它。
overlay: 放射性示踪：在原子水平看生命

shots.section_title: 放射性示踪：在原子水平看生命
shots.scene: 放大镜对准细胞，光点清晰可见
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a cell diagram where the glowing dots are clearly visible. No people.
shots.narration: 看清它在生命体内怎么走，别的方法难做到。

shots.section_title: 放射性物质推动医学进步
shots.scene: 心脏、大脑、血糖仪三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a heart, a brain and a blank glucose meter. No people.
shots.narration: 心血管病、神经疾病、糖尿病都靠它研究。
overlay: 放射性物质推动医学进步

shots.section_title: 放射性物质推动医学进步
shots.scene: 一条向上的阶梯，每级一个医学图标
shots.prompt_en: A rising staircase with a medical icon on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 几十年来的医学进步，离不开放射性物质。

shots.scene: 实验台上用过的手套、塑料管、玻璃器皿图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of used gloves, plastic tubing and glassware on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 有使用，就一定会产生废物。
overlay: 有使用，就有废物

shots.scene: 这些物品图标上沾着发光的小点
shots.prompt_en: The same items shown with small glowing dots on them. No people.
shots.narration: 接触过放射性物质，它们就被沾污了。

shots.section_title: 专人收集，送专用处理间
shots.scene: 老李推着收集车来到实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in gloves pushes a waste collection cart to a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 专门人员到实验室上门收集。
overlay: 专人收集，送专用处理间

shots.section_title: 专人收集，送专用处理间
shots.scene: 收集车进入一间门上贴电离辐射标志的专用房间
shots.prompt_en: The collection cart enters a dedicated room with an ionizing radiation warning sign on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 送到专用的废物处理间。

shots.section_title: 检查评估，专用容器封装
shots.scene: 老李戴手套检查废物袋，旁边空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in gloves and safety glasses inspects a sealed waste bag next to a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 先检查、评估，看清是什么废物。
overlay: 检查评估，专用容器封装

shots.section_title: 检查评估，专用容器封装
shots.scene: 废物袋放入不同的专用容器，盖子合上
shots.prompt_en: Waste bags are placed into different dedicated containers and the lids close. No people.
shots.narration: 再分别装进专用容器封装好。

shots.section_title: 监测核对标签上的活度
shots.scene: 老李用手持检测仪靠近废物桶，读数屏空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a handheld survey meter with a blank display near a waste drum.
shots.narration: 专业人员要用仪器再测一遍。
overlay: 监测核对标签上的活度

shots.section_title: 监测核对标签上的活度
shots.scene: 检测仪图标和空白标签图标之间一个等号和绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter icon and a blank label icon with an equals sign and a green check between them. No people.
shots.narration: 核对实验室在标签上登记的活度。

shots.section_title: 监测核对标签上的活度
shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个桶，桶上一个问号被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a waste drum; a question mark above it is crossed out.
shots.narration: 每个桶里有多少放射性，都要心中有数。

shots.section_title: 装满密封贴标，送去处置
shots.scene: 装满的桶被盖紧，扣上箍圈
shots.prompt_en: A full waste drum gets its lid closed tightly and a locking ring fastened. No people.
shots.narration: 桶装满后，密封。
overlay: 装满密封贴标，送去处置

shots.section_title: 装满密封贴标，送去处置
shots.scene: 桶身贴上电离辐射警告标志和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign and a blank label are stuck onto the drum. No people.
shots.narration: 贴上规定的标志和标签。

shots.section_title: 装满密封贴标，送去处置
shots.scene: 一辆专用运输车图标驶向远处的处置设施
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated transport truck icon drives toward a distant disposal facility. No people.
shots.narration: 再交给专门的设施去处置。

shots.section_title: 暂时存放，安全安保第一
shots.scene: 运输车图标前面亮起红灯，桶留在原地
shots.prompt_en: A red stop light appears in front of the truck icon, and the drums stay where they are. No people.
shots.narration: 如果暂时送不出去，只能先存放。
overlay: 暂时存放，安全安保第一

shots.section_title: 暂时存放，安全安保第一
shots.scene: 上锁的暂存间里整齐排列的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Waste drums lined up neatly inside a locked storage room. No people.
shots.narration: 存放期间，安全和安保永远第一。

shots.section_title: 教学楼不是长期贮存库
shots.scene: 一栋教学楼图标，里面堆满废物桶，打上黄色警示
shots.prompt_en: A teaching building icon packed with waste drums, marked with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 教学楼并不是为长期贮存设计的。
overlay: 教学楼不是长期贮存库

shots.section_title: 教学楼不是长期贮存库
shots.scene: 欣欣指向远处一座专门的处置设施图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points toward a distant icon of a purpose-built disposal facility.
shots.narration: 长远看，要有正规的永久处置设施。

shots.section_title: 这是所有医学科研机构的共同难题
shots.scene: 多家医院和研究所图标，每家门口都有废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Several hospital and research institute icons, each with waste drums at the door. No people.
shots.narration: 这不是一家单位的事。
overlay: 这是所有医学科研机构的共同难题

shots.section_title: 这是所有医学科研机构的共同难题
shots.scene: 这些图标被一条线连到同一个问号
shots.prompt_en: All these building icons are connected by lines to one big question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 做医学科研和临床的地方，都会遇到。

shots.section_title: 废物多是干燥固体，层层包装
shots.scene: 一个桶的剖面：里面是干燥的手套和塑料袋
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a waste drum showing dry gloves and plastic bags inside. No people.
shots.narration: 这类废物大多是干燥的固体。
overlay: 废物多是干燥固体，层层包装

shots.section_title: 废物多是干燥固体，层层包装
shots.scene: 废物外面一层袋、一层桶、一层外箱，像洋葱一样
shots.prompt_en: Layers around the waste like an onion: a bag, a drum and an outer container. No people.
shots.narration: 外面还有一层又一层的包装防护。

shots.section_title: 废物多是干燥固体，层层包装
shots.scene: 欣欣在一群人图标前讲解
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot explains to a small crowd of people icons in front of a blank board.
shots.narration: 讲清楚是什么，才能消除误解。

shots.section_title: 安保要求高，集中处置更稳妥
shots.scene: 放射性物质图标外加一把大锁
shots.prompt_en: A radioactive material icon with a big padlock on it. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质的安保要求越来越高。
overlay: 安保要求高，集中处置更稳妥

shots.section_title: 安保要求高，集中处置更稳妥
shots.scene: 分散的小桶图标汇集到一座有围墙的设施
shots.prompt_en: Scattered small drum icons gather into one walled facility with a gate. No people.
shots.narration: 集中到按安全和安保设计的地方更稳妥。

shots.scene: 教室、实验室、诊室三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a classroom, a lab and a clinic room. No people.
shots.narration: 教学楼是用来教学、科研和服务的。
overlay: 建筑各有用途

shots.scene: 教学楼里堆满桶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a teaching building packed with waste drums, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能让它变成长期的废物仓库。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着两本空白法规书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds two blank law books.
shots.narration: 国内对放射性废物有专门的法规。
overlay: 国内法规与学校管理

shots.scene: 王老师在办公室翻看空白台账，墙上电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank ledger in an office with an ionizing radiation warning sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 学校有辐射安全管理机构和专人负责。

shots.scene: 学校—学院—实验室三层组织图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-level organization icon: university, school, laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 小研在实验前看空白方案，旁边一个向下的箭头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reviews a blank plan before an experiment, with a downward arrow icon beside her.
shots.narration: 最好的办法，是从源头少产生。
overlay: 源头减少废物

shots.scene: 小量试剂瓶和铺着吸水纸的托盘图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small vial and a tray lined with absorbent paper. No people.
shots.narration: 按需领用，在托盘里操作，少沾污。

shots.scene: 放射性废物桶和普通垃圾分开，普通物品不进放射性桶
shots.prompt_en: Clean packaging stays in an ordinary bin while only contaminated items go into the radioactive waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 没沾污的东西，不往放射性桶里塞。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手套放进带电离辐射标志的专用桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his gloves into the dedicated bin with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 放射性废物，放进专用容器。
overlay: 实验室分类收集

shots.scene: 普通垃圾桶和水槽图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary trash bin icon and a sink icon, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不混进普通垃圾，不倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 固体桶、液体瓶、锐器盒三个专用容器图标
shots.prompt_en: Three dedicated container icons: a solid waste bin, a liquid waste bottle and a sharps box. No people.
shots.narration: 固体、液体、锐器分开收集。

shots.scene: 两个桶，分别贴着长短不同的沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: Two bins, one with a short hourglass icon and one with a long hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同核素、长短半衰期也要分开。

shots.scene: 小研在空白标签上书写，标签贴在废物袋上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank label attached to a waste bag.
shots.narration: 每袋废物都要贴好标签。
overlay: 容器和标签要规范

shots.scene: 空白标签和检测仪图标并排，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon next to a survey meter icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 如实填写，后面的人才能核对。

shots.scene: 容器盖子盖紧，外面干净无沾污
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with its lid closed and a clean outer surface. No people.
shots.narration: 容器要盖严，外表面不能沾污。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 门上挂锁的暂存间，门口电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A storage room door with a padlock and an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存间要专用、上锁、有标志。
overlay: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 老李和王老师一起清点废物桶，在空白台账上登记
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator count waste drums together and write in a blank ledger.
shots.narration: 进出登记，定期清点，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 暂存间里屏蔽墙和整齐的桶
shots.prompt_en: Inside the storage room, drums stand neatly behind a shielding wall. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时加屏蔽，无关人员不得进入。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁的桶，时间过去后检测仪亮绿灯
shots.prompt_en: A drum next to an hourglass icon; after time passes, a survey meter beside it shows a green light. No people.
shots.narration: 短半衰期的废物，可按规定衰变处理。
overlay: 国内的处置去向

shots.scene: 空白检测报告和审批印章图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank survey report and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 要经监测、经批准，不能自己说了算。

shots.scene: 专用运输车图标驶向有资质的收贮单位
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated transport truck icon drives to a licensed waste storage facility icon. No people.
shots.narration: 其余的交有资质的单位收贮。

shots.section_title: 处理废物的防护与监测
shots.scene: 老李穿实验服、戴手套和护目镜，胸前剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses and a dosimeter clipped on his chest.
shots.narration: 收集、搬运废物，要穿戴防护。
overlay: 处理废物的防护与监测

shots.section_title: 处理废物的防护与监测
shots.scene: 长柄夹子和推车图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of long-handled tongs and a cart. No people.
shots.narration: 用工具搬运，别抱在怀里。

shots.section_title: 处理废物的防护与监测
shots.scene: 老李离开前用手持检测仪查手和鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks his hands and shoes with a handheld survey meter before leaving.
shots.narration: 离开前，检查手和鞋有没有沾污。

shots.scene: 倒在地上的废物袋和空的位置上的问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a torn waste bag on the floor and an empty shelf spot with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 废物泄漏、丢失或被盗，都是事故。
overlay: 丢失、泄漏要报告

shots.scene: 小研拉起警戒线，阿杰在线外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sets up a barrier tape while the young male student stays outside it.
shots.narration: 先隔离现场，别让人走进去。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—学校
shots.prompt_en: A reporting chain icon: laboratory, school, university safety office. No people.
shots.narration: 报告负责人、学院和学校主管部门。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话记录
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone and writes on a blank notepad.
shots.narration: 丢失被盗报保卫处，有人受伤打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现示踪光点和医学图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of glowing tracer dots and medical symbols.
shots.narration: 放射性物质推动了医学研究。
overlay: 小结

shots.scene: 手套、塑料管、玻璃器皿进入专用桶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, plastic tubing and glassware going into a dedicated radioactive waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 用过就有废物，分类放进专用容器。

shots.scene: 标签和检测仪图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon and a survey meter icon with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 标签如实填，专人会监测核对。

shots.scene: 上锁的暂存间和台账图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a locked storage room and a blank ledger. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存上锁有台账，安全安保第一。

shots.scene: 运输车驶向有资质的收贮单位
shots.prompt_en: A transport truck icon heads to a licensed storage facility icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定处置，出了问题马上报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手套放进专用桶，向小研竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drops his gloves into the dedicated bin and gives the female graduate student a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰记住了：一副手套也不能乱扔。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的废物暂存间门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera outside a tidy, locked waste storage room door.
shots.narration: 管好废物，守好安全，下次见！
